cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(original_routing_engine VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
set(NATIVE_ENGINE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../weather-routing-engine" CACHE PATH "Shared routing contracts and validator")
if(NOT TARGET weather_routing_engine)
  set(WEATHER_ROUTING_ENGINE_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(WEATHER_ROUTING_ENGINE_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory("${NATIVE_ENGINE}" native)
endif()
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
add_library(hardened_original_engine STATIC src/Contour.cpp src/Engine.cpp src/GshhgProvider.cpp src/shoreline/Dataset.cpp)
target_compile_features(hardened_original_engine PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(hardened_original_engine PUBLIC include PRIVATE "${NATIVE_ENGINE}/src")
target_link_libraries(hardened_original_engine PUBLIC weather_routing_engine ZLIB::ZLIB)
set_target_properties(hardened_original_engine PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
option(ORIGINAL_ROUTING_BUILD_TESTS "Build Original engine contract tests" ON)
if(ORIGINAL_ROUTING_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  add_executable(original-contract-tests tests/contracts.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(original-contract-tests PRIVATE hardened_original_engine Threads::Threads)
  add_test(NAME original-contracts COMMAND original-contract-tests)
endif()
